name: unsigned-temporary-service
condition: High-severity newly installed or changed unsigned service plus temporary executable or unfamiliar baseline evidence
basis: MITRE T1543: create or modify a system service for persistence.

name: unfamiliar-scheduled-task
condition: High-severity scheduled task executing from a temporary directory combined with first sighting, after-hours activity or randomized task name
basis: MITRE T1053: scheduled tasks can provide repeated execution.

name: unfamiliar-startup-entry
condition: High-severity newly added unexpected Startup folder executable with a concrete autostart path
basis: MITRE T1547.001: Startup folder can be used for execution on logon.

name: repeated-unsigned-service
condition: Repeated new unsigned service registrations over an unusual remote event
basis: MITRE T1543: repeated unsigned service installation raises persistence confidence.

name: combined-persistence-channels
condition: Startup item and scheduled task both point to the same temporary executable
basis: MITRE T1547.001 and T1053: independent persistence channels pointing to the same temporary payload.

name: persistence-review
condition: Isolated task change, uncertain signature, temporary executable without service installation, or one-off modification
basis: MITRE T1543/T1053: incomplete evidence deserves alert, not automatic isolation.
